name: LiTe-GS
aliases: Oracle-Efficient NBV Selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting
definition: An oracle-efficient next best view selection framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that reduces the number of Fisher oracle evaluations by performing randomized subset evaluation of candidate views rather than exhaustively scoring the full candidate pool.
summary: LiTe-GS is an oracle-efficient active next-best-view selection framework for 3D Gaussian Splatting that reduces computational cost by evaluating only a randomized subset of candidate views using stochastic submodular optimization.
